For the upcoming cooler weather, I need a spring/autumn product from Adidas in size S. To ensure its quality, it should have fewer than 40 two-star reviews and also needs to arrive in under two days. Next, I'm searching for some size 36 women's 'Lightweight Sneakers' that are a reliable choice, meaning a total sales volume over 2100 and fewer than 15 one-star reviews. For summer, I want an 'All-Star Classic Skort' that's a bestseller with monthly sales over 600, fewer than 5 one-star reviews, and, again, a transport time of less than two days. Lastly, I need a versatile, all-seasons 'Sunbeam' item from Li-Ning with fewer than 10 two-star reviews. I'm looking for something that costs somewhere in the range of 2165 to 2180.
